title: Yellowed Cheesy Vietnamese Chicken Noodles
description: A tangy and savory Vietnamese dish featuring chicken, noodles, and dried apricots, with a cheesy pull and a hint of dashi extract, all served on a slate tile.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped green onions to the skillet and cook until fragrant.
Add the dashi extract, fish sauce, and lime juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the chopped dried apricots to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the apricot mixture.
Add the shredded cheese to the skillet and stir until melted and well combined.
Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and stir to combine with the cheese and noodle mixture.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the yellowed cheesy Vietnamese chicken noodles on a slate tile.
